mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_chat_message ( chat_message_seq, chat_room_seq, sender_seq, content, regdate ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{chatRoomSeq}, #{senderSeq}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_message_seq AS "messageId", chat_room_seq AS "chatRoomSeq", sender_seq AS "senderSeq", content AS "content", TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" FROM tbl_chat_message WHERE chat_message_seq = #{messageId}

SELECT chat_message_seq AS "messageId", chat_room_seq AS "chatRoomSeq", sender_seq AS "senderSeq", content AS "content", TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" FROM tbl_chat_message WHERE chat_room_seq = #{roomId} ORDER BY chat_message_seq ASC
